one_liner_zh: 默克第二季每股虧損小於預期，營收年增5.07%，整體表現優於市場預期。
one_liner_en: Merck reported a narrower-than-expected loss per share with a 5.07% YoY revenue increase, beating market expectations.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：每股虧損實際值-0.13美元優於預估的-0.26美元
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘實際值-0.13美元，優於市場預期的-0.26美元
季度營收達166.1億美元，較去年同期成長5.07%
核心藥物業務維持穩健動能，支撐營收成長
highlights_en: EPS came in at -$0.13, beating the estimated -$0.26.
Quarterly revenue reached $16.61 billion, representing a 5.07% YoY growth.
Core pharmaceutical operations maintained stable momentum supporting revenue growth.
risks_zh: 本季仍處於每股虧損狀態，獲利結構需持續修復
高達116.36的追蹤本益比顯示評價面臨壓力
risks_en: The company remains in a net loss per share position, requiring continued earnings repair.
A trailing PE ratio of 116.36 indicates potential valuation pressure.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：默克本季財報優於預期展現基本面韌性，但本益比偏高。短中期需觀察核心藥品銷售動能與獲利回升速度，建議追蹤後續毛利率及研發費用支出變化。
ai_view_en: view: Merck's beat demonstrates fundamental resilience despite high valuation. Near-to-mid-term implications depend on core drug sales momentum and earnings recovery speed. Track gross margins and R&D expense trends.
